# Auth0: integrations

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Auth0 integrations allow connecting third-party identity providers and application frameworks to Auth0's authentication platform. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: specific integration endpoint paths for each third-party system. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact callback URL patterns and required redirect URI formats. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: status codes returned by Auth0 integration endpoints and their meaning. Agents should extract the integration name, the required configuration fields, the callback URL format, and the authentication flow sequence from the source document.

Search intents:
- Auth0 integration setup
- OAuth callback URL configuration
- OIDC endpoint paths

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/auth0-integrations --json
